channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Cam Thomas | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Cam Thomas from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Jamal Crawford, Lou Williams, Cam Thomas
item.description:
The 24-year-old’s performance was so impressive that Doc Rivers compared Thomas to two of the greatest Sixth Men ever whom he coached during his 27-year NBA career.

“It’s unbelievable. I’ve had Jamal Crawford, I’ve had Lou Williams, and now I have Cam Thomas,”

Doc Rivers on Jamal Crawford, Lou Williams, Cam Thomas, Feb 12, 2026. Source: BasketNews.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Cam Thomas
item.description:
Kevin Durant on Cam Thomas:

“I feel like Cam has a bright future. It just takes somebody to believe in his talent and his skill. Scorers and guys that score the basketball at a high rate, they get taken for granted in this league a bit. We’re so used to loving defenders, playmakers, and guys that can be connectors. Sometimes scorers get taken for granted. Hopefully, somebody takes a chance on Cam and gives him what he deserves and puts the ball in his hands and builds around him and lets him grow into a player. What is he 24? He’s still got a lot of time in this league to keep getting better. Hopefully a team puts some trust in him.”

Kevin Durant on Cam Thomas, Jan 1, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Jordi Fernandez on Cam Thomas
item.description:
Brian Lewis:Jordi Fernandez:

“You can learn how to put everything together. You can learn how to pressure the ball. (Cam Thomas) is a great defender. If he doesn't get better it's because we have to do a better job. So he's willing…And now it's time to start seeing improvement.”

Jordi Fernandez on Cam Thomas, Nov 2, 2025. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Lewis.

item.title: Jordi Fernandez on Cam Thomas
item.description:
Brooklyn Nets coach Jordi Fernandez on Cam Thomas’ season and the future:

“Cam’s been great for the group. He’s worked every single day. He’s built relationships. We all know his superpower of being a very good scorer.““The way we played through him, I thought the team was playing at a high level.”

Jordi Fernandez on Cam Thomas, Mar 15, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Jordi Fernandez on Cam Thomas
item.description:
Jordi Fernandez on Cam Thomas' season ending hamstring injury:

“Yeah, disappointed. We feel for him. Obviously it's not something that we wanted. And we'll support him, support him through the rehab. We know he'll be back.”

Jordi Fernandez on Cam Thomas, Mar 15, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Jordi Fernandez on Cam Thomas
item.description:
Jordi Fernandez on Cam Thomas' performance:

“The ball was moving [in the first half], and I think Cam Thomas was the reason. We played through him. He passed the ball early, and then the ball had energy and it got back to him. He had 16 points in the first half. Then [the second half] was just part of him getting back in playing shape and playing over 30 minutes, which was good to see. And once he gets to play at that intensity and physicality [he had in the first half] for the whole game, it’s gonna be scary.”

Jordi Fernandez on Cam Thomas, Mar 11, 2025. Source: Twitter @erikslater_.

item.title: Jordi Fernandez on Cam Thomas
item.description:
Jordi Fernandez on easing Cam Thomas back into the rotation after his hamstring injury:

“To get to the real minutes, per se, it’s not gonna happen right away, because we have to be careful and cautious... But we’re ready for him to perform with the minutes he can play right now.”

Jordi Fernandez on Cam Thomas, Feb 28, 2025. Source: Twitter @erikslater_.

item.title: Jordi Fernandez on Cam Thomas
item.description:
Jordi Fernández on if there's a Cam Thomas update:

“No. Just on-court activities, no contact, but he's done a great job, and everything looks good.”

Jordi Fernandez on Cam Thomas, Jan 21, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Jordi Fernandez on Cam Thomas
item.description:
Brian Lewis:Jordi Fernandez on Cam Thomas' return:

“He's done a great job to get himself healthy and ready to play with his teammates... We're excited to have him back. His teammates were excited. He was excited, had a smile on his face. So it's a good day for us.”

Jordi Fernandez on Cam Thomas, Dec 29, 2024. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Lewis.

item.title: Jordi Fernandez on Cam Thomas
item.description:
Brian Lewis:Jordi Fernandez on Cam Thomas:

“Yeah. so he'll be on a restriction. I'm not going to tell you guys the minutes for obvious reasons. And I'm not going to tell you if he starts...but we need CT to be CT. We all know how efficient he's been. His superpower is scoring.”

Jordi Fernandez on Cam Thomas, Dec 29, 2024. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Lewis.

item.title: Jordi Fernandez on Cam Thomas
item.description:
Jordi Fernandez on Cam Thomas' performance against the Clippers:

“He scored 12 points on four shots. Where I come from, that’s pretty elite... He did a great job on both ends. He didn’t try to do too much... Obviously, we have to give him the ball and he has to score for us, but it was a very good first game with being very efficient with the shots he had.”

Jordi Fernandez on Cam Thomas, Oct 11, 2024. Source: x.com.

item.title: Cam Johnson on Cam Thomas
item.description:
“Dorian’s on the Brooklyn Nets right now. [Cam Thomas], [Trendon] Watford, we’re Nets right now, so that’s what we’re focused on is that group. And if something happens, then something happens. But that’s how we keep the main thing the main thing. “There’s plenty to work on in the meantime, plenty of things to focus on. So I’m having conversations with Jordi and them as if I’m fully 100 percent on the team all the way through. That’s where I want to be right now, and I’m cool with that.”

Cam Johnson on Cam Thomas, Jul 15, 2024. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Kevin Ollie on Cam Thomas
item.description:
Kevin Ollie on Cam Thomas:

“I love him at the point. He gets everybody involved. He’s doing a great job to give us another added dimension... He’s controlling matchups... And his teammates know it. His teammates are saying, ‘CT bring it up and control the game for us.’”

Kevin Ollie on Cam Thomas, Mar 27, 2024. Source: Twitter @erikslater_.

item.title: Kevin Ollie on Cam Thomas
item.description:
Erik Slater:Kevin Ollie on whether he views Cam Thomas as a Most Improved Player candidate:

“I definitely do... What he did the other day, I thought that was one of his best games... It's been amazing to see his growth since I got here, how he’s retaining things that we want him to do.”

Kevin Ollie on Cam Thomas, Mar 12, 2024. Source: Twitter @erikslater_.

item.title: Jacque Vaughn on Cam Thomas
item.description:
Jacque Vaughn on Cam Thomas' timetable:

“He didn't participate in shootaround... Tomorrow's an off day so that kind of puts us in a tough position to schedule actual practice for him. Hopefully we'll get to a point where we can simulate some things with some video and G-League guys maybe in this week coming up.”

Jacque Vaughn on Cam Thomas, Nov 26, 2023. Source: Twitter @erikslater_.

item.title: Jacque Vaughn on Cam Thomas
item.description:
Jacque Vaughn on Cam Thomas' sprained ankle progressing:

“He was on court shooting the basketball last time I saw him. Hopefully that continues to progress and he gets to a position where we can practice one of those days when we get back home.”

Jacque Vaughn on Cam Thomas, Nov 22, 2023. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Lewis.

item.title: Jacque Vaughn on Cam Thomas
item.description:
Vaughn on Cam Thomas' sprained ankle:

“He's a hooper and he wants to be here playing. We actually left him in Brooklyn so that you want the swelling (to go down)...So he'll get treatment and we'll reassess him in 2 weeks.”

Jacque Vaughn on Cam Thomas, Nov 10, 2023. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Lewis.

item.title: Austin Rivers on Blake Griffin, Patty Mills, Cam Thomas
item.description:
Mike Singer:Austin Rivers on his IG live right now:

“You should've seen the Nets team that we were playing tonight. Patty Mills, Blake Griffin, Cam Thomas were the only ones we knew.”

Austin Rivers on Blake Griffin, Patty Mills, Cam Thomas, Dec 20, 2021. Source: Twitter @msinger.
